description:
You are working on the WeatherApp Android project which is currently open in Android Studio. The project contains a WeatherUtils utility class with meteorological calculation functions and a comprehensive set of unit tests in WeatherUtilsTest.kt.

Your task is to configure JaCoCo (Java Code Coverage) reporting so the team can track test coverage.

Modify the file app/build.gradle.kts to:

1. Apply the 'jacoco' plugin in the plugins block
2. Configure JaCoCo with toolVersion set to "0.8.12" (or a compatible 0.8.x version) in a jacoco {} block
3. Register a custom Gradle task named 'jacocoTestReport' of type JacocoReport that:
   a. Depends on 'testDebugUnitTest'
   b. Enables HTML report output (reports { html { required.set(true) } })
   c. Sets sourceDirectories to include src/main/java and src/main/kotlin
   d. Sets classDirectories from the debug compiled output (app/build/tmp/kotlin-classes/debug), excluding generated files with these patterns: **/R.class, **/R$*.class, **/BuildConfig.*, **/Manifest*.*, **/*Test*.*, **/databinding/**, **/android/**
   e. Sets executionData to the test execution data file (app/build/jacoco/testDebugUnitTest.exec)

After making the changes, the command './gradlew jacocoTestReport' should run the unit tests and produce an HTML coverage report at app/build/reports/jacoco/jacocoTestReport/html/index.html.

Do NOT modify the existing WeatherUtils.kt or WeatherUtilsTest.kt files. Only modify app/build.gradle.kts.
